title: Search-in-the-Chain: Interactively Enhancing Large Language Models with Search for Knowledge-intensive Tasks
authors: Shicheng Xu; Liang Pang; Huawei Shen; Xueqi Cheng; Tat-Seng Chua
why_relevant: SearChain addresses knowledge conflict between LLM parametric knowledge and retrieved evidence via IR-based verification with confidence-gated correction, and uses LLM-indicated missing knowledge flags to decide when to retrieve—relevant to conflict handling and retrieval control.
why_not_or_caveat: Primarily a multi-hop QA reasoning framework; robustness/conflict handling is a component rather than core focus, and no systematic evaluation under adversarial or noisy retrieval.
